findings.reason: The protected app-local and Accepted native sources use the deterministic KMP prefix function to identify the longest palindromic prefix, including the empty-string boundary, and prepend exactly the unmatched suffix in reverse. This is a concise conventional O(n)-time, O(n)-space solution, so no candidate is justified.

The former a...ab inputs had an (n - 1)-character palindromic prefix, so a repeated-prefix solution stopped after two checks and did not exercise its quadratic class. Legal 512/2,048/8,192-character inputs now have only a one-character palindromic prefix and bind size directly to n; KMP passes, while the correct repeated-prefix reversal passes every output but fails scaling (+0.37 relative exponent).

The exact KMP derivation and minimality argument are retained, the alternatives and boundaries now have explicit required labels, and the Optimal summary now states the actual prefix-function and suffix-mirroring steps.
